_comment: Single source of truth for the preflight gate. Edit THIS when a rule changes — not prose in LESSONS.md. Every tag added here must be independently verified on that platform first (see LESSONS 'Verified hashtags'). Keep LESSONS.md pointing here.

youtube.#cinematicprompts: returns zero on YouTube — brand terms go in backend Studio metadata, not the visible row
youtube.#nanobanana: not indexed on YouTube — the real variant is #nanobananapro

banned_everywhere.#multiscenevideo: invented from descriptive language — had no real audience, underperformed

#aiproductphotography.reason: commerce/product tag — verified real but only relevant to product/fashion/marketing content, NOT wildlife/nature/narrative pieces

generator_names_note: Never in visible caption copy. Allowed only in a line marked 'Backend tags:' or an App Store keyword section.

banned_phrases.no wasted credits: the app reduces waste, never eliminates it — say 'fewer wasted credits'
banned_phrases.zero waste: same — the generator can still miss
banned_phrases.never miss: the app writes the prompt; the generator can still miss
banned_phrases.harsh noon: not a real lighting name — the five are dawn, sunny, Golden Hour, blue hour, night

tiktok.example: No studio. No photographer. No shoot.

youtube.example: Now Pick Your Camera Angle — New in Cinematic Prompts

facebook.example: AI Nature Documentary — West Coast Ocean
